eureka.discovery_use: A template for learning or searching the training interface while keeping the final discovery evaluator externally specified.
eureka.limits: The LLM designer is not itself updated by RL in this loop. Simulation control scores and reward novelty do not demonstrate scientific mechanism discovery.

agenttuning.discovery_use: A concrete data-collection and SFT baseline before RL, with explicit environment transcripts and retention controls.
agenttuning.limits: Success filtering discards potentially informative failed experiments. General agent transfer is not direct evidence of scientific discovery or calibrated belief updating.

rest-react.evidence: Inspected multi-step search evaluation and the ablation in which manual filtering of locally bad steps did not improve final accuracy.
rest-react.discovery_use: Evidence against a blanket rule that only superficially correct intermediate steps should be retained; selection must match end-to-end objectives.
rest-react.limits: The result is task- and data-size-dependent, using small QA evaluation sets and model-based judgments; it does not prove that erroneous scientific claims are suitable positive demonstrations.

star.evidence: Inspected the bootstrapping setup and arithmetic/commonsense evaluation, including discussion of judging rationale quality.
star.discovery_use: A reasoning-training comparison for success-filtered self-training, especially when contrasting known-answer tasks with discovery lacking answer labels.
star.limits: Known training answers are required for filtering/rationalization. Correct final answers do not guarantee faithful reasoning or valid experiment choice.

classification_review.rationale: Iteratively generates rationales and fine-tunes on correct answers; rationalization conditions on known answers to recover additional training examples. restem.discovery_use: A simple self-training baseline that isolates whether expensive multi-turn RL is needed beyond verified trajectory reuse.
restem.limits: Its binary verified-reward experiments differ from noisy, delayed scientific evidence. Training and validation leakage controls must be redesigned for test-time use.

classification_review.rationale: Alternates policy sampling with reward annotation and reward-weighted likelihood training, instantiated with correctness-filtered math/code solutions. search-r1.evidence: Inspected the RL objective, iterative search-stop protocol, rejection-sampling comparison and held-out QA evaluation setup.
search-r1.discovery_use: A practical precedent for training tool selection from terminal rewards while respecting which trajectory tokens were actually generated by the policy.
search-r1.limits: Exact-match QA rewards measure retrieval-assisted answering, not intervention value or new scientific knowledge. A fixed retrieval corpus can conceal distribution and contamination effects.

classification_review.rationale: Optimizes search-interleaved LLM rollouts with PPO/GRPO and masks externally returned retrieval tokens from policy optimization. Its main contribution concerns training objectives, policy learning, meta-learning, or the data and feedback used to form capabilities.

dibs.method: Introduces a latent differentiable distribution over DAGs and performs approximate joint graph/parameter posterior inference with particle-based variational methods.
dibs.evidence: Inspected gradient estimators and graph/predictive posterior evaluation, including expected SHD over equivalence classes.
dibs.discovery_use: Supplies an uncertainty-bearing belief model for selecting interventions rather than collapsing immediately to one guessed causal graph.
dibs.limits: Approximate posteriors depend on graph priors, likelihood assumptions and inference quality. Observational non-identifiability is not removed by differentiability.

classification_review.rationale: Introduces a latent differentiable distribution over DAGs and performs approximate joint graph/parameter posterior inference with particle-based variational methods. dag-gflownet.method: Constructs DAGs sequentially with a generative flow network trained to sample graphs proportionally to Bayesian scores rather than returning only a maximizing graph.
dag-gflownet.evidence: Inspected the detailed-balance setup, acyclicity masks and posterior-feature/graph comparisons.
dag-gflownet.discovery_use: An alternative to reward maximization when discovery requires diverse plausible hypotheses and uncertainty-aware experimental design.
dag-gflownet.limits: The demonstrated Bayesian-network setting assumes fully observed iid data and usable modular scores. Posterior graph diversity does not itself prove causal identifiability.

classification_review.rationale: Constructs DAGs sequentially with a generative flow network trained to sample graphs proportionally to Bayesian scores rather than returning only a maximizing graph. avici.discovery_use: A useful model of learning an inference procedure across worlds; separates amortized causal inference from learning a policy to gather data.
avici.limits: The simulator distribution acts as a prior. Amortization and good synthetic OOD scores do not overcome unobserved confounding or identification failures outside its assumptions.

csiva.discovery_use: A learned inference baseline that separates recovering structure from selecting which intervention data to acquire.
csiva.limits: Finite-data graph predictions inherit the training distribution and may contain cycles. Supervised synthetic graph recovery does not establish unrestricted causal discovery.

classification_review.rationale: A transformer maps observational/interventional datasets to an autoregressive distribution over graph adjacency entries, trained on synthetic graph/data pairs. citris.evidence: Inspected the minimal-causal-variable formulation, a necessary intervention-separation condition and interventional visual benchmarks.
citris.discovery_use: Shows why observation representation and available intervention diversity must be specified before measuring discovery-policy ability.
citris.limits: Guarantees are conditional on the temporal/generative assumptions and intervention coverage. Factors always manipulated together may not be separately identifiable.

classification_review.rationale: Learns visual causal representations from temporal transitions with observed intervention targets and an intervention-conditioned latent transition model. weakly-supervised-crl.discovery_use: A precise precedent for representation-level discovery with weak experimental supervision, rather than treating every new embedding as a discovered variable.
weakly-supervised-crl.limits: Identifiability is up to stated equivalences under substantial assumptions. Unknown intervention targets do not mean an unconstrained or intervention-free setting.

classification_review.rationale: Uses paired observations before/after unknown interventions to learn latent causal variables and mechanisms, with explicit and implicit causal-model parameterizations. llm-causal-frontier.discovery_use: Useful for defining which parts of causal reasoning can be elicited from pretrained knowledge and which require new data or intervention evidence.
llm-causal-frontier.limits: Language answers may reflect memorized associations or prompt sensitivity. A convincing argument or correct familiar edge is not new experimentally identified causality.

classification_review.rationale: Behaviorally probes language models on multiple causal tasks and discusses connecting text-based prior knowledge with statistical and logical causal methods. causal-agents.evidence: Inspected the proposed workflow and personality-data example, including discussion of partially identified graphs and latent-variable semantics.
causal-agents.discovery_use: A clear counterpoint to LLM-generated causal edges and a useful provenance contract for scientific harnesses.
causal-agents.limits: This is a methodological position and illustrative system, not proof that every use of language-derived priors is invalid. Declared and sensitivity-tested Bayesian priors must be distinguished from unreported model guesses.

classification_review.rationale: Advocates keeping causal claims tied to explicit assumptions, data and formal algorithms while agents assist data inspection, method selection and interpretation. Its main contribution supplies definitions, theory, or a synthesis of discovery research.

causalsteward.evidence: Inspected how proposed graphs constrain a discovery algorithm and how cross-partition edges are added during merging.
causalsteward.discovery_use: Exposes a testable boundary between domain-knowledge proposals, statistical tests and final graph commitments in a harness.
causalsteward.limits: Incorrect priors and partitioning can bias graphs; identifiability claims depend on assumptions and available evidence. The selected review did not independently check the theoretical proofs or reproduce experiments.

classification_review.rationale: Partitions high-dimensional variables, combines LLM/human prior knowledge with data-driven discovery in local graphs, and merges results through hypothesis/critic agents. tent.method: Updates normalization statistics and affine parameters online by minimizing prediction entropy on unlabeled target inputs.
tent.evidence: Inspected source/target-data access distinctions, corruption-error comparisons and feature-modulation ablations; some embedded figure text is poorly extracted.
tent.discovery_use: A compact label-free adaptation baseline and a warning that optimizing confidence differs from acquiring reliable new evidence.
tent.limits: Entropy can decrease for incorrect predictions. Image-corruption results do not establish usefulness for LLM scientific discovery, especially with new classes or mechanisms.

classification_review.rationale: Updates normalization statistics and affine parameters online by minimizing prediction entropy on unlabeled target inputs. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

eata.method: Selects reliable, non-redundant samples for entropy adaptation and regularizes important parameters to reduce forgetting.
eata.evidence: Inspected selection/weighting criteria, Fisher-based preservation and clean-versus-corrupted accuracy during sequential adaptation.
eata.discovery_use: Suggests separate controls for update usefulness, compute cost and retained capability in a discovery-agent learning stream.
eata.limits: Low entropy is a heuristic for sample reliability, not scientific truth. Restricting updates to already confident examples may miss genuinely novel phenomena.

classification_review.rationale: Selects reliable, non-redundant samples for entropy adaptation and regularizes important parameters to reduce forgetting. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

cotta.method: Uses weight/augmentation-averaged teacher predictions and stochastic restoration toward source parameters while adapting across changing domains.
cotta.evidence: Inspected the online prediction/update order and repeated domain-sequence evaluation designed to expose forgetting.
cotta.discovery_use: A precedent for retaining a stable reference policy and testing revisited worlds after online agent updates.
cotta.limits: Vision-domain shifts and pseudo-label consistency are not verified discoveries. Restoration may preserve useful priors but can also resist necessary adaptation.

classification_review.rationale: Uses weight/augmentation-averaged teacher predictions and stochastic restoration toward source parameters while adapting across changing domains. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

ttt-plus.evidence: Inspected a failure example and assumptions behind a bound relating auxiliary-task information to main-task accuracy.
ttt-plus.discovery_use: A direct reason to validate that a test-time training signal aligns with discovery quality instead of assuming any self-supervised update helps.
ttt-plus.limits: The theorem requires distribution/feature conditions that need not hold for LLM agents. Source-moment storage differs from a fully source-information-free setup.

classification_review.rationale: Combines self-supervised adaptation with stored source feature moments and online alignment, using contrastive supervision and feature queues. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

ttt-mae.method: Adapts an image encoder to each test input with masked reconstruction while retaining a recognition head.
ttt-mae.evidence: Inspected training/probing alternatives, optimizer sensitivity and comparisons showing an auxiliary rotation objective can hurt rotation-invariant classes.
ttt-mae.discovery_use: Illustrates both per-instance adaptation and the importance of selecting an auxiliary objective compatible with the downstream scientific task.
ttt-mae.limits: Image reconstruction and its linear-model analysis do not establish causal learning. Update costs and stopping rules remain part of the evaluation budget.

classification_review.rationale: Adapts an image encoder to each test input with masked reconstruction while retaining a recognition head. Its main contribution concerns updates from feedback during deployment or across continuing investigations.

omni.discovery_use: A way to distinguish useful, learnable research questions from unlimited novelty or raw prediction error.
omni.limits: Interestingness inherits human/model priors and can be gamed. A finite task space or finite experiment does not demonstrate indefinitely sustained open-endedness.

omni-epic.discovery_use: A concrete model for generating discovery-training worlds and curricula from a persistent record of competence and failures.
omni-epic.limits: Open-ended generation remains bounded by the simulator, code APIs and evaluators. Generated-task success is not evidence of transfer to unmodeled real-world science.

classification_review.rationale: Uses language/vision models to generate task descriptions and executable environments, train agents, and retain learned/failed tasks in an evolving archive. Its main contribution generates new challenges or modifies agent designs and improvement procedures.

mle-bench.discovery_use: A practical long-horizon experimentation benchmark with executable outcomes and compute-sensitive comparisons.
